claim: Dinner-only hours 18:30–21:00, VND 1,000,000 deposit per person required, smart casual dress code, Wine Spectator Award of Excellence 2018–2024
quote: Our goal is to captivate your senses with beautiful, inventive cuisine and a curated, thoughtful selection of wines.

claim: March 2026 menu: Epicurean 7,599,000 VND++ with lobster/caviar/wagyu; Gourmand 5,999,000 VND++; wine pairings at matching price; à la carte from 899k–4,499k VND

claim: La Maison 1888 retained its Michelin star in 2025 (second consecutive year); Christian Le Squer is the inspiring chef; Florian Stein is Chef de Cuisine on-site
quote: To retain a MICHELIN star is a great honour. It reflects the consistency and refined artistry of our cuisine, which constantly evolves to evoke emotion.

claim: Michelin Guide listing confirms 1 Michelin star, French cuisine, located in Da Nang
quote: 1 Michelin Star — High quality cooking, worth a stop

claim: 4.4/5 rating from 571 reviews; ranked #100 of 1,981 Da Nang restaurants; one couple reported spending ~$600 for two; some service timing complaints (3 hours for 6 courses)
quote: Exquisite cuisine. Attentive service and amazing setting. Worthy of its Michelin awards.

claim: March 2025 first-hand review: dishes included Kristal caviar bisque, langoustine, scallop mousseline, foie gras, poularde with truffle; reviewer assessed food as 'not as refined as expected at a Michelin-starred restaurant' post-chef transition; transport by Grab (~20 min)
quote: The food was a bit lacking I think, but don't take me wrong... issues arose from chef change and inadequate on-site supervision during transition.

claim: Interior: La Veranda seats 24; Buffalo Bar has 14 indoor and 30 outdoor seats; kitchen counter seats 14 with panoramic views; one 4-seat private room; two 12-seat private chambers
quote: The restaurant occupies an elegant French-colonial mansion nestled within forest grounds at the InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort.

claim: Architect Bill Bensley designed the space in classic Indochine style; Florian Stein leads daily operations and has researched local Central Vietnamese herbs and seafood
quote: Architect Bill Bensley designed the space, blending 'classic Indochine style with modern lines.'

claim: Christian Le Squer holds three Michelin stars at Le Cinq in Paris's Four Seasons George V; travels to Vietnam monthly to oversee operations; dining described as 'a sublime experience'

claim: Address: Bai Bac, Tho Quang, Son Tra; children 12+ welcome in main dining; families with under-12s accommodated in exclusive family rooms; groups of 6+ may require deposit
quote: Children 12 and older welcomed at main dining. Families with children under 12 accommodated in exclusive family rooms.

claim: 2023 diner report: $868 for two on 7-course menu with wine; transport by Grab to the resort; staff attentive and accommodating; sorbet and veal were highlights
quote: The total cost was $868 for two people dining on the full 7-course menu.

claim: The Nam Tram is a 130-meter cable car spanning four levels (Heaven/Sky/Earth/Sea), designed by Bill Bensley in the form of a traditional Vietnamese basket boat; all guests use it to navigate the hillside resort

claim: Third-party roundtrip transfer service from Da Nang city center to La Maison 1888 is available to book, confirming non-guests can access the resort for dinner

claim: La Maison 1888 is among just nine one-star restaurants in Vietnam and is the only one in Central Vietnam
